review_fields.extraction_sha256: canonical digest of worklist case target_extraction
review_fields.manual_check_completed: Boolean true only after actual review
review_fields.problem_extraction_accurate: Boolean from actual original-source comparison; missing required extraction component is false
review_fields.method_extraction_accurate: Boolean from actual original-source comparison; missing required extraction component is false
review_fields.result_extraction_accurate: Boolean from actual original-source comparison; missing required extraction component is false
review_fields.extraction_errors: actual list of extraction errors; empty only after review finds none
review_fields.corrections: actual list of corrections with annotation references and source locations; never overwrite original annotations

adjudication_fields.review_records_sha256: digest of this case's review records sorted by reviewer_id
